findings.finding: Substantial perturbation-evoked internal activity can occupy output-null dimensions and have negligible downstream readout effect until it enters output-potent dimensions.
findings.impact: A downstream null result is weak falsification when treatment-to-readout observability is unverified. This directly supports the Audit R10 causal-opportunity concern for Candidate #35.

sources: Downstream network transformations dissociate neural activity from causal functional contributions, PMID 38267481
findings.finding: Observed local activity patterns can dissociate from causal contribution after downstream network transformations; multi-site perturbation is needed to resolve contribution more rigorously.
findings.impact: H7's comparator-capacity failure is scientifically substantive. Lesion/cut magnitude alone is insufficient for a unique responsibility claim in a distributed system.
